policy: Count successful original-manager backing allocations through a copied first-party subclass in complete unchanged baseline/candidate cold/warm encodes. Outputs, inputs and owned peaks/closure must match the prior independent/public proof. Buckets are constructor plus ceil(log2(max(1,bytes))). These counts exclude JS heap, unowned arrays, caller/sink and allocator internals. Instrumentation is diagnostic; no speed/RSS causality or production/parity qualification.
